api.name: Predicate
api.title: Predicate
api.description: A yes/no test of an exchange for filter, when, loopDoWhile and validate: matches(exchange). In the DSL a predicate is usually a language expression (simple: ${header.foo} == 'bar'); write it in Java when the test needs code, or use a bean method that returns boolean.

matches.description: true when the exchange passes the test.
